records.text: An explosives demonstrator said a 20-gram PETN charge produced a hole in NIJ Level IV glass about the same diameter as a .30-06 gunshot.
records.speaker: Explosives demonstrator (unidentified)

appearances.snippet: 20 gram booster, PETN charge. We're going to use it against the transaction window to see what the results are. ... make like a laser beam through the guy's head. It's about the same as a gunshot. This is NIJ4 rated glass. Yeah, from a thirty-ought-six, so it's about the same foot diameter.

verification.notes: The embedded demonstration clip directly records a 20-gram PETN booster being used against a transaction window and the demonstrator comparing the resulting hole with a .30-06 gunshot in NIJ Level IV-rated glass. This verifies the demonstrator’s reported statement, not equivalence of the mechanisms or relevance to Kirk’s death.
